subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) She was born on June 9 in Kaptai and grew up in Sylhet at Shahzibazar though her home district is in Khulna. (b) Her father was confident about her and her sister to contribute on a Table Tennis Championship in 1974 where she became runners up with her sister becoming first. (c) When she was eight years old she started playing as a hobby and in 1974, her hobby turned into a developed aim. (d) This is the best period ever in any country in the world. (e) Zobera Rahman Linu, a famous Bangladeshi table tennis player, is the only one Bangladeshi sportswoman to have her name listed in the Guinness Book of World Records. (f) She won 16 national championships during 1979 to 2001. (g) She stood championship in singles, doubles and mixed doubles in 1977. (h) Linu is a national Goodwill Ambassador in Bangladesh working for UNICEF.
guide_solution: e a c b g f d h Zobera Rahman Linu, a famous Bangladeshi table tennis player, is the only one Bangladeshi sportswoman to have her name listed in the Guinness Book of World Records. She was born on June 9 in Kaptai and grew up in Sylhet at Shahzibazar though her home district is in Khulna. When she was eight years old she started playing as a hobby and in 1974, her hobby turned into a developed aim. Her father was confident about her and her sister to contribute on a Table Tennis Championship in 1974 where she became runners up with her sister becoming first. She stood championship in singles, doubles and mixed doubles in 1977. She won 16 national championships during 1979 to 2001. This is the best period ever in any country in the world. Linu is a national Goodwill Ambassador in Bangladesh working for UNICEF.
